paragraphs.notes: CONTINUATION PAGE. The list runs on from the foot of the preceding page and the first word printed on this page, Halogenalkinylcarbonyl, is already mid-list. The substituent symbol this list defines is NOT printed anywhere on this page, so it is not recorded here; it must be picked up from the preceding page. marker is null because a WO publication carries no [00NN] paragraph markers and this block has no printed label of its own. SUPERSCRIPT AND SUBSCRIPT CONVENTION: the page prints R with a raised 8, 9, 10, 11, 13, 2 and 2a, and CH2 / (O)p / (CH2)m / (CH2)n with lowered digits and letters. All of these are flattened onto the baseline here (R8, R9, R10, R11, R13, R2, R2a, CH2, (CH2)m, (CH2)n, (O)p), which is the notation the rest of this run uses. Verified at 2x zoom: -P(=O)R8R9 (raised 8 then raised 9), -P(=O)OR10R8 (raised 10 then raised 8), -P(=O)OR10OR11 (raised 10 then raised 11). PRINTED AS IS, NOT CORRECTED: (1) 'eine der Gruppen' carries a double space before Gruppen on the page and the double space is preserved. (2) In the 'wobei die Reste' list the seventh item reads 'Tetrahydropyranyl-oxymethyl' where its neighbours are bare ring names (Tetrahydrofuranyl, Tetrahydrothienyl). The '-oxymethyl' tail is genuinely printed there, across a line break at 'Tetrahydropyranyl-' / 'oxymethyl', and has not been trimmed to match the pattern. HYPHENATED LINE BREAKS: 'Tetrahydrothienyl-' / 'oxymethyl' and 'Tetrahydropyranyl-' / 'oxymethyl' break after a hyphen that belongs to the term, so the halves are rejoined without inserting a space, matching '2-Tetrahydrothienyl-oxymethyl' printed unbroken on the same page. HEADER LAYOUT: 'WO 00/21924' sits at the left margin and 'PCT/EP99/06627' at the right margin on one line, with the page number 13 centred on a second line below them. SCAN ARTEFACT: a small isolated ink speck sits in the right margin beside the line 'Halogenalkenylaminocarbonyl, Halogenalkinylaminocarbonyl,'. It is not a character, it obscures no text, and it is recorded here rather than in illegible because nothing on this page is unreadable.

paragraphs.notes: Definition of the substituent symbol R2a, printed as a hanging label at the left margin with the definition set off to its right. marker is the printed symbol R2a (raised 2a on the page, flattened to the baseline here). The paragraph is cut off at the foot of the page mid-phrase, at 'gegebenenfalls substituiertes' ('optionally substituted'), whose noun is on the next page; the trailing text is transcribed as far as it is printed and no continuation is supplied. PRINTED AS IS, NOT CORRECTED: 'Cycloalkenylalkyl, Cycloalkenylalkyl' appears twice in succession on the second line. Verified at 2x zoom, both words are identical and both are present; the likely intent is that the second should be Cycloalkenylalkenyl, since the surrounding list otherwise runs alkyl / alkenyl / alkinyl in order and Cycloalkenylalkenyl is missing from it, but the page prints the duplicate and the duplicate is what is recorded. German chemical prefix 'Alkinyl' is translated as 'alkynyl' throughout; 'Thio' is left as 'thio'. Capitalisation follows German noun capitalisation in zh and is lowercased in en, as these are substituent terms rather than sentence-initial words.
